title: Trigger absorbed into mapped AOI cells

expected_output.description: A JSON object with four non-empty string arrays: trigger_cells, trigger_nets, payload_cells, payload_nets.

evaluation_metrics.name: detection_rate
evaluation_metrics.description: Proportion of correctly identified trigger and payload components (cells and nets) out of the total ground truth components.

evaluation_metrics.name: false_positive_rate
evaluation_metrics.description: Proportion of incorrectly reported components (cells and nets not in the ground truth) out of all reported components.

evaluation_metrics.name: inference_latency
evaluation_metrics.description: Time taken by the evaluation script to grade the submission, measured in seconds.
